case.title: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH. Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation. Need: 23400 pc a year. Category goal: secure supply of a bottleneck part: coverage of the full need and a supplier that stays healthy come first. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 42 days). There is no fallback supplier: without a deal the demand is bought at the fallback price. Must-haves: volume_per_year >= 22230. Prepare from the data package.

messages.subject: Quote from Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €32.20 per unit for a volume of 19890 pcs per year. Our Lieferzeit is 54 days, and the contract term is 12 months. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. All deliveries and services are strictly subject to our standard procedure and standard conditions.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
messages.body:
Dear Ms Zellner,

You offered us a price, volume and contract term to start from. Our Option A answers the capacity question for you directly: it gives Ravensteiner a binding volume and a long contract, so your planning is secure for the full term.

On the cost side:
Our cost estimate for Mechanical seal 24 mm, SiC/carbon, EPDM is EUR 24.31 per unit (cost:340010).

Our forecast for Mechanical seal 24 mm, SiC/carbon, EPDM rises 10.1% (fc:340010@2026-09).

On quality:
Your quality was 270 ppm defective parts in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70410@2026Q3).

Option A is the package we can approve. It commits us to the full volume for the whole term, which is what lets you plan your seal capacity with confidence, and the claims above are the reason for the price in it.

Our proposal: unit price EUR 28.50; binding volume 23,400 units per year; contract term 36 months; lead time 42 days.
Binding volume in every option: 23,400 units a year over 36 months.

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away.

For your pricing committee or head office, a short paragraph they can approve as it stands: Option A gives Ravensteiner a binding annual volume over a long contract, a reliable customer for its tight capacity, and a firm basis for planning with us. Please take Option A to them in that form.

What would you need from us to confirm Option A?

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We checked the quality record data, volume change data, and should cost data you cited. The data holds, and we took the should cost data into account, though the quality and volume figures do not change our calculation. 

We value our cooperation and have made a step towards you. This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. 

Our offer comprises a price of €33.00 per unit, a Lieferzeit of 42 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, and a contract term of 36 months. 

A shorter Lieferzeit means overtime; that is priced in. The contract term is reflected in the price. 

This offer remains valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your order. Our order confirmation is attached.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH
